What Is the Mysterious Profession of "Breast Milk Tamer"?! — Episode 1-4

Premise:

"Wait—am I supposed to save the world with my breast milk!?" Azusa—a girl on the slightly bustier side—wakes up in the other world she’s been transported to, only to discover her assigned *Job* is... a Breast Milk Tamer!?
n: [Manga] Nazo no shokugyō [bonyū teimā] ttena ndesu ka! ? 1-4
